consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the performance of the 1981-03-23 show at the Rainbow Theater is exceptional, particularly praising the first set and the energy throughout the concert. Many highlight the impressive execution of several songs, making it one of the standout shows of 1981.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 12 reviews + 0.8 sentiment: The overall enthusiasm for the performance, despite some critiques of the recording quality, leads to a positive sentiment adjustment.
